about: Celler Pardas is the project of two friends from the Penedès, winemaker Ramon Parera and agronomist Jordi Arnan, who founded it in 1996 at Can Comas, a 60-hectare estate in the Bitlles river valley near Torrelavit in the Alt Penedès. The property, centered on a farmhouse of medieval origin, mixes Mediterranean forest, cereal fields and pasture with roughly 30 hectares of vines. They replanted in the late 1990s with cuttings from old native vines and released their first wines from the 2004 harvest. They make wine only from their own grapes.

Pur Xarel·lo is 100% Xarel·lo, the Penedès’ signature white grape, from vines around 40 years old in several parcels on shallow, poor, lime-rich soils over a hard calcareous crust. The vineyards are organically farmed, unirrigated and untilled, with natural cover crops. After gentle gravity pressing, the juice ferments with native yeasts, part in new 500-liter French oak barrels and part in a 1,600-liter concrete egg, and it matures in those same vessels until bottling. The wine is not clarified, and production is around 6,500 bottles.

Expect a savory, mineral white built to age, with focused flavors and lively acidity; one reviewer likened it to the whites of the Loire. Quince, marzipan and dried apple hint at the gentle richness the oak and concrete bring. A Norwegian critic who tasted the 2021 suggested enjoying it through 2029, with shellfish and fish as natural partners.
